world.title: Woman Leans Against Hotel Window In Brazil, Falls To Death After Its Frame Breaks | Video
world.summary: A 26-year-old woman in Brazil fell to her death after leaning against a hotel window, which broke. A video shows a man accompanying her standing still for a few seconds before realizing the incident. The tragic event highlights safety concerns regarding hotel windows. Authorities are investigating the circumstances surrounding the incident to determine further details.

world.title: At least two children killed in bus crash in eastern France, authorities say
world.summary: At least two children were killed and 16 others injured in a bus crash on Friday morning in eastern France, near the Swiss border, according to local authorities. French Prime Minister Sebastien Lecornu confirmed the fatalities in a post on X. The incident has prompted an investigation into the circumstances surrounding the crash. Further details are pending.

business.title: Asia’s Fuel Oil Market Signals Hopes of U.S.-Iran De-Escalation
business.summary: Asia’s high-sulfur fuel oil margin decreased to a $2.29 discount this week amid growing hopes for U.S.-Iran de-escalation. The outcome of the U.S. midterms has fueled optimism for reduced tensions in the Middle East, potentially allowing increased oil product movement from the Strait of Hormuz. This has contributed to a slump in refining margins and benchmark prices.

business.title: Hero Xtreme 125R Stealth Edition Launch Price Rs 1.16 Lakh in India
business.summary: Hero MotoCorp has launched the Xtreme 125R Stealth Edition in India at a price of Rs 1.16 lakh (ex-showroom). This motorcycle features a TFT instrument cluster with advanced connectivity options and introduces a segment-first Tyre Pressure Monitoring System (TPMS). The new model aims to enhance rider experience with its technological advancements and modern design elements.

business.title: Bharti Airtel reclaims No. 2 spot among India's most valuable companies, overtakes Jio Platforms
business.summary: Bharti Airtel has regained its status as India's second-most valuable listed company, surpassing Jio Platforms with a market capitalisation of Rs 13.15 lakh crore. This change follows a 31% year-on-year increase in Q2 net profit. The shift occurs amid a strong rally in benchmark indices, which have risen for seven consecutive sessions.

technology.title: “Piracy Is a Fact of Life,” Says Take-Two CEO as GTA 6 Nears Launch
technology.summary: Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick discussed piracy concerns surrounding the imminent launch of GTA 6. He expressed that while piracy is a significant issue in the gaming industry, he is not overly worried. Zelnick outlined the company's strategies to address piracy, emphasizing that it is a common challenge faced by many game developers, particularly with major releases like GTA 6.

technology.title: Windows 11 27H2 Could Be The Biggest Windows Upgrade Since 2024, With Major Performance Improvements And New Wallpapers
technology.summary: Microsoft is planning a significant upgrade for Windows 11, designated version 27H2, set for release in 2027. This update aims to enhance performance and reliability, focusing on substantial under-the-hood improvements. Additionally, users can expect new wallpapers as part of the upgrade. The company is prioritizing this overhaul instead of launching Windows 12 in the near future.

technology.title: Apex Legends Godzilla collaboration - Release date, cosmetics, new game mode & more
technology.summary: Respawn Entertainment announced a collaboration between Apex Legends and Godzilla, set to launch on November 10, 2026, shortly after Godzilla Day, which marks the franchise's 72nd anniversary. The event will feature 10 exclusive Legend skins and the Dorsal Dagger weapon. Additional details about the new game mode and cosmetics are expected to be revealed closer to the release date.

sports.title: ECB to raise concerns over funding of Afghanistan Premier League
sports.summary: The England and Wales Cricket Board (ECB) plans to express concerns regarding the funding of the Afghanistan Premier League (APL). Despite the league conducting its player draft, it has not received official approval from the International Cricket Council (ICC). The ECB's apprehensions highlight the ongoing issues surrounding the legitimacy and financial backing of the APL.

sports.title: India vs Nepal Highlights U19 Asia Cup: Aaryavir Sehwag rips through Nepal to give India big win
sports.summary: India's U19 cricket team secured a 10-wicket victory over Nepal in their Asia Cup opener. Aaryavir Sehwag scored an unbeaten 69 off 51 balls, while captain Lakshya Raichandani contributed with an unbeaten fifty. India chased down Nepal's total of 129 runs in just 19.1 overs. Ishan Sood excelled with the ball, taking 3 wickets to dismantle Nepal's top order.

sports.title: Mega LSG-RR trade in the offing
sports.summary: Lucknow Super Giants (LSG) and Rajasthan Royals (RR) are in discussions for a potential trade involving three or four players, including a batter and a fast bowler. The RR management is particularly interested in acquiring a pacer who performed well with LSG last season. The deal is not yet finalized, and negotiations are ongoing between the two franchises.

health.title: Muscle loss increases type 2 diabetes risk: Doctor explains why strength matters more than you think
health.summary: Muscle loss can significantly increase the risk of type 2 diabetes, even in individuals who appear slim and maintain stable weight. This gradual decline in muscle mass, often due to aging or inactivity, reduces the body's ability to clear glucose from the bloodstream. Consequently, decreased muscle mass may lead to insulin resistance and heightened diabetes risk.

health.title: India Leads South East Asia's NTD Elimination Drive, Yet Dengue And Leprosy Cases Surge: Report
health.summary: India has successfully eliminated three neglected tropical diseases, including trachoma and visceral leishmaniasis, as public health problems. The elimination of trachoma was achieved in 2024, while visceral leishmaniasis was eliminated in all endemic blocks by 2023. However, the country is experiencing a surge in dengue and leprosy cases, highlighting ongoing public health challenges despite these achievements.

health.title: Navigating the Cardiometabolic Pathways of Child Feeding in India
health.summary: The first 1,000 days of a child's life, from conception to their second birthday, are crucial for health and development. In India, feeding practices during this period significantly influence cardiometabolic pathways and long-term health outcomes. Proper nutrition is essential for establishing a strong foundation for human capital, impacting children's growth, cognitive development, and overall well-being throughout their lives.

science.title: Octopuses Follow Two Strategies to Squeeze Through Tiny Holes
science.summary: Octopuses utilize two strategies to navigate through small openings, leveraging their unique anatomy. Unlike animals with rigid skeletons, octopuses possess flexible bodies supported by a muscular hydrostat, allowing for movement without bones. This adaptability enables them to squeeze through tight spaces, showcasing their remarkable dexterity and problem-solving abilities in various environments, highlighting their evolutionary advantages in survival and mobility.

science.title: NASA Astronaut Anil Menon Completes Nearly 7-Hour Spacewalk To Install Final Solar Array
science.summary: NASA astronauts Anil Menon and Joshua Kutryk completed a nearly seven-hour spacewalk to install the final solar array on the International Space Station (ISS). During the operation, astronauts Luke Delaney and Jessica Watkins utilized the Canadarm2 robotic arm. This spacewalk signifies the completion of an upgrade to enhance the ISS's power capabilities, supporting future missions and research.

science.title: Octopuses follow two strategies to squeeze through tiny holes
science.summary: Octopuses are known for their ability to navigate through tight spaces. Research has revealed that they employ two distinct strategies to achieve this. Scientists studied how octopuses manipulate their eight arms and flexible bodies, organizing them into specific sequences to fit through small openings. This insight enhances understanding of their unique locomotion and adaptability in various environments.

entertainment.title: SCOOP: Salman Khan and Jio Studios strategise December 4 release for Maatrubhumi against Eetha; distribution battle intensifies
entertainment.summary: Salman Khan and Jio Studios are planning to release the film Maatrubhumi on December 4, competing against Eetha. Recently, Jio Studios stepped down as the distributor for Eetha, which stars Shraddha Kapoor, leading to PVR Pictures taking over distribution. This shift has created significant buzz within the industry, intensifying the competition between the two films.

entertainment.title: Mahesh Babu Calls Ranbir, Yash And Sai Pallavi "Magical" As Ramayana Continues Box Office Run
entertainment.summary: Mahesh Babu praised the cast of "Ramayana: Rise of a Legend," calling Ranbir Kapoor, Yash, and Sai Pallavi "magical." The film, directed by Nitesh Tiwari, premiered on November 5 and has been well-received at the box office. Babu congratulated the team for successfully adapting the epic for cinema, contributing to its ongoing popularity and acclaim.

entertainment.title: Salman Khan at ‘Maatrubhumi’ trailer launch: Focus on Ram’s qualities, not ‘Ramayana’ budget or VFX
entertainment.summary: At the trailer launch of his film 'Maatrubhumi: May War Rest in Peace', Salman Khan addressed discussions surrounding 'Ramayana'. He emphasized that conversations should focus on the qualities of Lord Ram rather than the film's budget or visual effects. Khan's remarks aimed to redirect attention to the essence of the epic, rather than its production aspects.
